body: Credibility-generated forward test (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.42 (naive sector base rate 0.43) that: Sansera's dedicated defence facility is operational by 31-Mar-2027. Probability set only by the pre-stated rule (research_notes/Promise tracker pilot/AUTO_COMPONENTS_peer_comparison.md section 5): p0 = 0.43 (leave-one-out peer strict delivery rate, category 'capacity', n=18); SAC -4.8 pts x weight 0.286 (N=8) -> p = 0.42. Evidence: Q2FY27 call (06-Nov-2026): 'our dedicated facility is expected to begin operations towards the end of Q3 FY 2027'; Q&A 'towards the end of the third quarter or from the fourth quarter'. Resolution: YES if a Q3/Q4 FY27 call, presentation or NSE filing states the dedicated defence facility began operations on or before 31-Mar-2027. Source: Sansera Q3/Q4 FY27 earnings call transcripts (NSE). Resolve by 2027-06-15; score with Brier vs the base rate, to test whether the credibility adjustment adds skill.

data.adjustment_applied: p0 = 0.43 (leave-one-out peer strict delivery rate, category 'capacity', n=18); SAC -4.8 pts x weight 0.286 (N=8) -> p = 0.42
data.adjustment_rule: p0 = leave-one-out pooled STRICT delivery rate (specificity-weighted share 'delivered'; partly=0) of the other 4 peers in the promise's category (all-category peer rate if <8 peer promises in that category). p = clip(p0 + N/(N+20) x SAC/100, 0.05, 0.95), N = company's scored promises, SAC in points (credit basis: delivered 1, partly 0.5; categories with n<5, or with <2 peers having data, pooled). P(base) = p0.
data.base_rate_reasoning: Naive forecaster = sector delivery rate for 'capacity' promises among the other auto-component peers (strict: delivered only, specificity-weighted; n=18). No company-specific information.
data.resolution_rule: YES if a Q3/Q4 FY27 call, presentation or NSE filing states the dedicated defence facility began operations on or before 31-Mar-2027.
data.resolution_source: Sansera Q3/Q4 FY27 earnings call transcripts (NSE)

title: Paper call: Sansera's dedicated defence facility is operational by 31-Mar-2027
